metadata.name: Quality Standards — ISO 25010, WCAG 2.1, OWASP
metadata.proposito: Defines quality standards that the team and the AI workflows must follow

atributos_calidad.atributo: Explicit criteria, V1/V2 validation, verifiable evidence
Input validation, AuthN/AuthZ, do not expose secrets, parameterized queries, HTTPS
Clear states (loading/success/error/empty), immediate feedback, specific errors, WCAG 2.1 AA when applicable, responsive
Optimized queries, lazy loading, reasonable bundle; optimize only if necessary
Minimal change, reuse, no unnecessary refactor, tests, incremental documentation
Robust error handling, transactions, E2E tests, error-case validation
Do not break existing functionality, contracts respected, backward compatibility

metrica.name: Test Coverage
metrica.objetivo: ≥ 80% global and 100% on the user story's security/validation rules

metricas_objetivo.metrica: pytest-cov, Vitest/Jest, or the stack equivalent

metrica.name: Quality gates
metrica.objetivo: 100% green before commit and before push

metricas_objetivo.metrica: format_lint, typecheck, architecture, tests, migrations, build
Stack brought up with containers or real processes

validacion_hu.fase: V2 (specialists): Tests executed + correction of V1 noncompliance
